en: A battery and closed switch electrify a small bulb through a complete circuit.

Subject electrify meaning 電気を流す. A simple educational complete SERIES circuit ONLY objects no person: horizontal battery at bottom, small yellow lit bulb at upper right, CLOSED switch upper left. ONE wire from LEFT battery terminal to switch, ONE wire switch to bulb, ONE wire bulb to RIGHT battery terminal. Both opposite battery ends connected separately. Three wires form single closed loop. No extra branches. All components fully inside frame. Bulb filled solid pale yellow with 2 short DARK BROWN rays, NO glow or haze. No text.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. No watercolor grain, muddiness, speckles, mottling, paper texture, bleed or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
